items.text: Staff Site Reliability & Platform Engineer with 8+ years of experience operating multi-cluster k8s infrastructure, cloud automation, observability stacks, and high-availability production systems.

entries.heading: Staff Site Reliability Engineer | Stratos Cloud Platform | 2021 – Present

items.text: Architected and operated 14 production k8s clusters (EKS and GKE) spanning 2,400+ compute nodes and 350 microservices at 99.99% control-plane availability.
Automated zero-downtime k8s control-plane upgrades, blue/green node-group cordoning, and PodDisruptionBudget validation across all environments.
Provisioned multi-account AWS and GCP landing zones using modular TF and Terragrunt with Atlantis pull-request workflows and OPA policy guardrails.
Built a unified observability platform with Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry distributed tracing ingesting 1.2M active time-series across 90 microservices.
Authored custom k8s operators in Go (controller-runtime) and self-serve platform CLI tools in Python to automate namespace bootstrapping and RDS credential rotation.
Negotiated 99.95% availability targets and p99 latency thresholds with 12 product squads, automatically freezing non-emergency deploys when 30-day burn rates exceeded 25% of allowable downtime.
Directed live mitigation war rooms for SEV-1 outages as primary incident commander and instituted no-fault retrospective reviews that cut repeat pages by 62% over 12 months.

Engineered cross-region traffic shifting between us-east-1 and us-west-2 with automated Route53 health checks and ran monthly fault-injection drills terminating production AZ nodes, validating sub-90s RPO/RTO.
Rolled out Cilium CNI with eBPF kube-proxy replacement and Istio mTLS across 600+ nodes, enforcing zero-trust service-to-service traffic policies.
Trimmed annual cloud infrastructure bill by $1.1M (28%) by migrating stateless worker pools to Karpenter-managed preemptible EC2 capacity and purchasing 3-year Compute Savings Plans.
Migrated 800+ legacy console-created cloud resources into version-controlled TF state with automated drift detection running every 4 hours.
Designed GitOps continuous delivery pipelines using ArgoCD and Helm charts, reducing mean time to rollback failed production releases from 22 minutes to 45 seconds.
Hardened container runtime security with Falco syscall monitoring, read-only root filesystems, and HashiCorp Vault dynamic secret injection.
Replaced self-managed Elasticsearch log clusters with Grafana Loki backed by S3 object storage, cutting log storage expenditure by 54%.
Mentored 5 senior and mid-level infrastructure engineers and authored the engineering-wide production readiness checklist required for tier-1 service launches.
Eliminated noisy alert fatigue by consolidating 180 threshold-based Nagios checks into symptom-based multi-window Prometheus alerting rules.
Built an internal Slack bot in Python to notify engineering managers when quarterly security training compliance budgets were exhausted.
Tuned Linux sysctl kernel parameters (net.core.somaxconn, tcp_tw_reuse) on cloud VM base images to prevent ephemeral port exhaustion under load.
Conducted peer-to-peer architecture reviews with application security and compliance teams prior to SOC 2 Type II audits.
Collaborated with the enterprise analytics group to evaluate domain-oriented data mesh ownership boundaries in Snowflake.
Configured temporary office Wi-Fi Ubiquiti access points and conference room VLANs during headquarters relocation.
